# `pos refund` commands

## `pos refund lines`

Find a POS sale by receipt barcode/number, sale ID or ticket key. Return its line identities and remaining returnable quantities, including hand-entered credit memo claims. Requires pos.refund.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.refund |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.refund.lines` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos refund lines --sale counter-cart-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos refund lines", "input": {"sale": "counter-cart-1"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sale` | `--sale` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.refund.lines`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sale_id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `receipt_number` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `pos_register` | object | yes | no | — | — |
| `pos_register.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `pos_register.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `customer` | object \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `customer.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `customer.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_method` | object | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_method.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_method.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_method.kind` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `lines` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `lines[].source_line` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `lines[].item_id` | string | yes | no | — | — |

## `pos refund receipt`

Read a POS refund for printing or reprinting, by refund ID, operation key, credit memo ID or number in sale. The receipt says REFUND and identifies money returned or store credit. Captured lines and totals survive subsequent document changes. Needs pos.refund; off unless pos_enabled is on.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.refund |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.refund.receipt` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos refund receipt counter-return-1 --reprint --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos refund receipt", "input": {"sale": "counter-return-1", "reprint": true}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sale` | `SALE` | string | yes | no | — | POS refund ID, operation key, credit memo ID or original credit memo number.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `reprint` | `--reprint` | boolean | no | no | false | Mark this copy Reprint without changing the sale. |

| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_WORK_DEPENDENCY` | The accepted or linked work prevents this change; inspect the related document. |
